sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-12 and 2016-12-12, internal automated monitoring identified suspicious transaction activity on card C09988-K1 belonging to customer C09988. Flagged transaction 3534820 in the amount of $59.67 was executed via card not present new device. The transaction was initiated from an unrecognized device (Windows |  | edge 16.0 | ). Cross-account analysis revealed this device fingerprint is concurrently linked to multiple cardholder accounts (C08106-K1), indicating organized multi-card harvesting or syndicate involvement. Cardholder was contacted and explicitly denied authorizing the charge while confirming physical possession of the card. Historical case memory retrieved relevant precedents (CC-1998, CC-1997) with confirmed fraud typologies. The financial institution has initiated preventive containment including card blocking and heightened monitoring of linked accounts. Total suspicious activity identified amounts to $59.67. This report is filed pursuant to regulatory requirements under Rule R2/R6.

stop_reason: Graph pattern and customer validation definitively confirmed unauthorized compromise. Containment actions established.
